title: PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) Rider: Warning Days for Repeated Low-Balance Disconnections
content:
For the reset of a PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) low-balance alert amount, the warning days follow the number of low-balance disconnections of the enrollment in the one-month window, counted by its disconnected alerts.

**Clause.** Where the enrollment was disconnected for low balance at least as many times as the tier's counseling referral count in the one-month window, the warning days are 7; where it was disconnected for low balance more than twice but fewer than the counseling referral count times in that window, the warning days are 5; with two disconnections in that window the warning days stay at the tier's disconnect warning days. Any increase of the warning days is added to the warning days set here.

The counseling referral count is 4 on PrePay Power Residential, PrePay Power Residential Recovery 25, PrePay Power Residential Recovery 40, PrePay Power Seasonal and PrePay Power Outbuilding, and 3 on PrePay Power Small Commercial. A window of a stated number of months takes the records dated after the same day of the month that many months before the current date, through the current date.

| Disconnections in the one-month window | PrePay Power Small Commercial | Every other tier |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | the tier's disconnect warning days | the tier's disconnect warning days |
| 3 | 7 | 5 |
| 4 or more | 7 | 7 |
